sentence: This project studies the molecular controls that set cell identity within tumors of rhabdomyosarcoma, a soft tissue sarcoma of childhood.
This project studies how heart dysfunction develops in Duchenne and Becker muscular dystrophy and looks for cardiac MRI measures that predict death.
This project studies how adult hippocampal neurogenesis and memory that depends on the hippocampus are affected in Alzheimer's disease.
This project provides immune monitoring services that help researchers understand anti-tumor immune responses in cancer immunotherapy trials.
This project studies real-world narratives and builds an AI-enabled storytelling prototype to learn about substance use disorder recovery support.
This project examines how a mutation in a chaperone protein causes cardiomyopathy and whether stimulating autophagic pathways for mitochondrial quality control prevents protein aggregates.
This project tries to find out which hurricane victims are at high risk of cardiovascular disease mortality and morbidity in the long term.
This project studies how lung damage from the virus that causes COVID-19 promotes a harmful inflammatory response and finds molecules that mediate it.
This project investigates how pathways in the brain connecting the amygdala with the reticular thalamic nucleus work and how they are disrupted in seizures.
This project develops gene editing that uses lipid nanoparticles to deliver CRISPR/Cas9 tools and correct the factor VIII gene in hemophilia A mouse models.
This project studies how a cell surface protein promotes tumorigenesis and metastasis in lung cancer and tests an inhibitory antibody as a treatment.
This project studies the molecular mechanisms that regulate autophagy, a way cells turn over dysfunctional organelles, in the axon of neurons.
This project helps researchers define the DNA replication, chromosomal and cellular outcomes when key regulators of homology-directed repair become dysfunctional.
This project builds a tool that uses a pangenome graph to find the inherited genome in a sequencing sample and detect disease-causing somatic genetic alterations.
This project uses spatial transcriptomics and proteomic methods to study the cellular and molecular effects of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias across brain regions.
This project tests whether gut dysbiosis with reduced fecal short-chain fatty acids increases mammary tumorigenesis in the offspring of obese dams.
This project provides biostatistics and bioinformatics support for discovery, translational, and clinical studies, including study designs and analysis of data.
This project provides samples of perturbed and healthy human skin, immune testing, and bioinformatics to learn about the keratinocyte and its environment.
This project studies how pediatric substance use relates to the rate of neuromelanin accumulation, a proxy for dopamine function, in the brain.
This project combines electronic health records with psychiatric and cognitive measures to predict risk for and course of psychopathology in young adults.
